name: dsh-harness-restart
description: 重启 DeepSeek Harness 进程并自动继续未完成工作：四层重启引擎（触发→审批→PRE 等待→EXIT→POST 恢复）、AI 二次认证、定时/每日/脚本回调、重启后按方案 B 渐进恢复已注册回调的会话（等 1 分钟、每 5 秒一个、回执超时提醒）、演练模式（simulateOnly 不真重启）、自愈双保险（supervisor 让位 + detached helper 健康探测重试）。Restart the DeepSeek Harness process and resume unfinished work: four-layer restart engine (trigger→approval→PRE wait→EXIT→POST restore), two-step AI authentication, daily/script callback scheduling, receipt-based progressive restore (1 min wait + one session per 5 s + unack reminder), simulate-only drill mode, and self-healing restart (supervisor yield + detached helper with health-check retries).

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/core.js && node --check lib/config.js && node --check lib/callbacks.js
scripts.test: node tests/unit.mjs && node tests/client-mock.mjs && node tests/v1-pre-schedule.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run release:check
